This secret '''training center''' on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to train elite [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] units. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], it was visited by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
